description: The complete mapping between the engine error numeric space (engine/include/cr/cr_error.h, cr::Err) and the UI connector error vocabulary (ui/src/connector/contract.ts, ConnectorErrorCode). Validate with contracts/validate.mjs. context overrides are keyed by the bridge call-site that can refine a code; 'surface' says where the UI sees it.

context.rule: When the bridge's fresh enumeration no longer lists the device, the bridge surfaces device-gone instead; the engine code alone cannot distinguish.
During scans, read failures arrive as CR_EVT_ERROR_RANGE (badSectorMap) and never as ConnectorError. As a recovery item failure the item row carries it. As a preview read failure: preview-damaged.

context.note: Defensive; indicates a bridge bug if ever seen.

context.rule: NOT an error: the bridge translates it to scan status 'cancelled' / recovery status 'cancelled' and never throws. The UI's cancel paths resolve, not reject.

context.note: Scan-time occurrences are error-range events, not ConnectorErrors.

context.rule: session_load on a non-CRSFMT01 container. In image-open context the UI has no surface (the 36 methods never open images).

context.note: cr_ui_scan_verify_identity mismatch on resume: the session came from a different volume.

context.rule: scan-scope-invalid when the failing parameter was pathScope; destination-invalid when it was a destination path; unknown otherwise (bridge bug).

context.note: Buffer-capacity truncation; the bridge sizes buffers via the two-call protocol — seeing this is a bridge bug.
Engine safety stop; the scan completes with partial results (event/stats surfaces carry the truth); never surfaced as an error dialog.

context.rule: health-unavailable from cr_ui_health_read; preview-unsupported from preview of an unsupported kind; not-implemented only on the three gap methods (dryRunRepair/getUndoLog/undoRepairs) whose surfaces are truthfully disabled (docs/INTEGRATION-GAPS.md G-1).

context.note: Fatal; the bridge logs with cr_ui_last_error text and the UI shows the generic error.

context.rule: The bridge pre-checks file existence: a missing file is session-not-found (no engine call is made); an I/O failure on an existing file is session-corrupt.

context.note: Item-level verify failure; the report row carries hash_status='mismatch'; the job completes-partial.
Rename space exhausted (engine cap): the item FAILS with a truthful reason; no synthesized fallback name.

context.rule: During enumeration the volume's status becomes 'locked' (DeviceStatus union member). If a scan is nonetheless started on it, the bridge throws device-permission with detail {bitlocker:true, reasonKey:'errors.volumeLocked'} — the UI's unlock flow (openPath via cr_ui_open_volume_with_key / cr_ui_unlock_volume_with_dictionary consent actions) runs from the volume's status surface.

mappings.surface: repair undo (CLI-only surface; listed for completeness)

context.note: The consent callback refused (A1). The UI sees repair-consent-required so the About/consent copy explains the denial.
No UI surface opens images (the 36 methods never call cr_ui_open_image; it is the ABI-check/test surface). Listed for completeness; mapped for the day a surface exists.

bridgeOnlyCodes.cause: scanId not in the bridge registry (unknown or closed id)
session file missing on load (bridge pre-check; engine never sees it)
pause/resume/cancel called on a scan that is not running (contract parity with the mock's token misuse errors)
resume called on a scan that is not paused
pathScope failed the bridge's validity check (absolute path under the target volume; null/omitted = whole volume)
destination path is not under a mount point / is malformed (bridge-side; engine backstops with 0x50030003/0x5005000x)
device absent from fresh enumeration (engine transport would give 0x50020001; the bridge refines)
preview request exceeds the bridge payload bound (image dataUrl assembly cap; hex reads are capped at 64 KiB per the bounded-payload principle ADR-003)
bounded metadata/read exceeded the bridge time budget (defensive; the engine itself is non-blocking)
node has no readable content (metadata-only row; e.g. metadata-only items the writer skips)
engine metadata kind == 'unsupported' (cr_ui_metadata.kind): the engine truthfully declines the preview; metadata is still shown. Engine source: ERR_UNSUPPORTED refinement.
encrypted-class file (engine metadata kind/extension classification): rendered preview refused, metadata shown
preview_unreadable reported zero-filled spans; the payload carries the truth (bounded hex/text with damaged ranges noted)
consent_respond requestId is unknown or already resolved (double respond, cancel force-deny, or the scan ended; G-1 (a) — the prompt treats it as stale and dismisses)
EXACTLY the four gap methods (dryRunRepair, applyRepair, getUndoLog, undoRepairs) — truthful disabled surfaces per docs/INTEGRATION-GAPS.md G-1; no other method may throw it

invariants: Every cr::Err value in engine/include/cr/cr_error.h has exactly one mapping row (context refinements recorded in-row).
ERR_CANCELLED never reaches the UI as an error.
Every ConnectorErrorCode in ui/src/connector/contract.ts is either mapped from an engine code or listed in bridgeOnlyCodes with a cause.
The bridge passes the engine code numerically in ConnectorError.detail.code; the UI renders reasonKey strings only (never string-matches messages).
